title: Cosmic Sorceress and Hounds
description: A fantastical surreal scene depicts a glowing female sorceress with long flowing purple and green hair, wearing a golden robe and floating in the sky with arms outstretched and purple energy emanating from her hands. Below her on a cracked desert landscape with ancient stone ruins, a large blue wolf with glowing red eyes leaps forward, a reddish-brown jackal-like hound with ornate collar and armor stands aggressively, and a translucent purple ghostly wolf runs in front. The dramatic sky features a cracked turquoise planet with rings, a swirling rainbow vortex portal, floating orbs, swords and broken pillars scattered on the ground.
